head.name: @fzlt/core/camera
head.lead: The page is the camera. Pan and zoom a DOM stage (any element) with one transform written through the engine's ledger, so Recall gives it back exactly. Moves ease and settle (the engine sleeps when they end); with reduced motion they jump. contain (default on) keeps the stage covering its own box, so no edge shows and the page never scrolls sideways. Coordinates: world = the stage's own untransformed CSS px (0,0 is its top-left corner); screen = the same box after the camera (what the visitor sees, in the stage's untransformed layout box).

npm install @fzlt/core
import { camera, zoomAt, flyTo, toScreen, … } from "@fzlt/core/camera";

blocks.label: EXAMPLE · typechecked against v0.27.0
blocks.code:
const cam = camera(e, stage, { min: 1, max: 4 }); // any DOM element
cam.to(320, 180, 2);   // eased; the engine settles when it lands
zoomAt(cam, x, y, 3);  // helpers stand alone: zoomAt, flyTo, fit, toScreen
cam.home();            // e.destroy() gives the transform back exactly
